name: Public Service Enterprise Group
description: PSEG is a New Jersey public utility holding company with two parts. PSE&G, a regulated transmission and distribution utility, delivers electricity to 2.4 million customers and gas to 1.9 million across a 2,600 square mile diagonal strip of New Jersey (about 74% of the state's population) and earns a return on its rate base rather than on the commodity. PSEG Power & Other owns nuclear plants (full Hope Creek, 57% of Salem 1 and 2, 50% of Peach Bottom 2 and 3), sells energy and capacity into the PJM market, supplies wholesale gas to PSE&G under a full-requirements contract, and runs the Long Island Power Authority operating-services agreement. The nuclear fleet is an unregulated generation business inside a mostly regulated company, which is why it falls between the standard boxes.

businessLines.name: PSE&G
businessLines.how: Customers pay delivery charges every month; the utility earns a return on net investment in rate base (9.6% ROE on distribution; FERC formula rates on transmission) and passes the electricity and gas commodity cost through, so it is largely unaffected when customers pick other suppliers.
businessLines.description: Regulated electric and gas transmission and distribution in New Jersey: 2.4 million electric and 1.9 million gas customers; transmission is under FERC formula rates, distribution under BPU rate cases.

businessLines.name: PSEG Power & Other
businessLines.how: Sells nuclear electricity and capacity into the PJM market (unregulated, so prices and outages matter), sells wholesale gas to PSE&G's default customers under a long-term contract, and earns operating-services fees from running Long Island's grid for LIPA.
businessLines.description: PSEG Power: nuclear generation (Hope Creek 1,174 MW at 100%; Salem 1 and 2 2,280 MW at 57%, 1,309 MW share; Peach Bottom 2 and 3 2,549 MW at 50%, 1,275 MW share, operated by a third party), wholesale gas supply to PSE&G, PJM energy and capacity sales, and PSEG Long Island's operating-services agreement with LIPA plus legacy investments.
